sloka: आख्यातं हि मया गत्वा पितृव्यस्य तवानघ ।इहोपयातं सर्वेषामेतेषां वनचारिणाम् ।। ५.६४.८ ।।।।
transliteration: ākhyātaṁ hi mayā gatvā pitṛvyasya tavānagha ।ihopayātaṁ sarveṣāmeteṣāṁ vanacāriṇām ।। 5.64.8 ।।।।

translations.english: "O blameless prince I have already told your father's elder brother and all the forestdwellers about your arrival here.
